newsitem.title: USA: Forcenergy prices 3.5 mln shrs, notes.
newsitem.headline: Forcenergy prices 3.5 mln shrs, notes.

text.p: Forcenergy Inc said on Friday it priced an offering of 3.5 million shares of common stock at $26.875 each.
It also priced $175 million of senior subordinated notes at par with a coupon of 9.5 percent.

Of the 3.5 million shares, 1,537,958 shares were offered by the company and 1,962,042 shares were offered by certain stockholders. Forcenergy granted the underwriters an option to purchase up to an additional 525,000 shares of common stock solely to cover over-allotments.

In connection with the common stock offering, Forcenergy's 13 percent exchangeable subordinated notes were converted into 2,343,047 shares of common stock. Of that amount, 1,662,042 shares were sold in the offering as part of shares sold by selling stockholders, it said.
The offerings are scheduled to close on November 6.
The equity offering was managed by Goldman, Sachs & Co; Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp; Howard, Weil Labouisse, Friedrichs Inc; and Prudential Securities Inc.
The subordinated notes offering was managed by Goldman, Sachs; Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp; Lehman Brothers; and Salomon Brothers.

The company expects to use total proceeds of $208 million to repay all outstanding indebtedness under the company's senior credit facility and for general corporate purposes, including possible acquisitions and capital expenditures.
Forcenergy is an independent oil and gas company based in Miami.
